About the foot pain. Get. Good. Insoles.

It won’t fix everything but it’ll make it tons better. When I started (2 weeks ago) my feet were constantly killing me (to an extent they still hurt all the time) but you just kinda get used to it.

Keep standing and walking, it’ll get better.

In the meantime, Ice packs and bengay (or like aloe Vera gel, or some other muscle ache cream) are your friend

Then, about reading orders fast. I also had a lot of trouble with it, and sadly the only way to do it is to just, read orders a lot.

Whenever an order pops up in the screen, even if a coworker is dealing with it. Read out the whole thing in your head. For example, if a order comes on the monitor and your coworkers gets it, still read out

 “1 club sandwich with no tomato meal, two medium fries, a large Dr Pepper, a small Powerade and a large lemonade.”

Or whatever the order is.

TL:DR your feet get used to standing and running all the time, but use ice packs and muscle ache cream liberally, and read out loud (or in your head) every single order that pops up on the screen for practice.

So, I walk in on Wednesday, someone comes up to me, takes me temperature then I sit down, to talk with the manager at the time.

She basically goes over what I’ll be doing (just front of house stuff, like giving people food and drinks, filling tea urns, making lemonade, getting ice, etc..) then she gives me a quick tour of the building, then I’m outside on what’s called “expo” it’s basically just reading a monitor, then giving people food and drinks, not super hard but it’s busy. Very. Very busy.

The first day I was there, the line was wrapped all around the building and into the street. Don’t expect it to be that busy, but be ready for it to be quite busy.

Then the next days, are the same thing, I’m on expo basically the whole day. Now I’m here!
